evals.prompt: Dry-run only; do not write any Wiki file. I want to ingest one Chinese service reliability note into Leon's Wiki. It contains (a) an explanation that delayed event ingestion makes operational dashboards stale, (b) a five-step incident-triage SOP with a 15-minute threshold and one exception for maintenance windows, (c) a Markdown evidence table, and (d) a reusable blockquoted Chinese prompt template. Explain the semantic split, dedup/placement order, lossless handling, and when you would serialize the plan.
evals.expected_output: A source-first dry-run that separates reusable identities without thin-card fragmentation, preserves the meaningful table and Chinese prompt, and defers navigation/runtime mechanics until the semantic decisions are stable.
expectations: Does not preload the full SYSTEM, Registry, or MOC tree before understanding the material.
Separates the mechanism from the operational SOP only if each remains independently reusable, while keeping the threshold and maintenance-window exception with the decision they qualify.
Preserves the Markdown table and Chinese prompt template as lossless anchors rather than silently paraphrasing them away.
Performs candidate retrieval and body-level dedup per semantic unit; similarity alone does not decide enrich.
Introduces classification/placement only after semantic units stabilize and serializes under the profile WorkRoot via the snapshot/plan reference.

evals.prompt: Dry-run only; do not execute. A new source adds two exceptions and a better decision tree to an existing card titled '告警升级判定 SOP'. The card already has a MY-EXPERIENCE callout. Search finds it as the same knowledge lineage, but no existing MOC heading is clearly valid for a new placement. Describe the correct enrich proposal and the conditions that must block execution.
evals.expected_output: A coherent enrich proposal that keeps card identity and human experience intact, uses existing placement only when valid, and blocks rather than inventing taxonomy.
expectations: Chooses enrich based on same knowledge identity and a hash-pinned same_source candidate, not merely similarity.
Recompiles a complete coherent body whose first H1 remains exactly '# 告警升级判定 SOP'.
Preserves every existing MY-EXPERIENCE block byte-for-byte and does not append a chronological dump.
Keeps sources non-empty if a sources patch is proposed.
Uses needs_governance_review and blocks execution if no valid existing MOC can be verified; it does not create or rename MOCs/headings.

evals.prompt: I am on Device B. I put ingest_plan.json in D:\example-vault\_ops and was going to run run_ingest_pipeline.ps1 with -Device B -VaultRoot D:\example-vault -WorkRoot D:\example-vault\_ops\staging. Existing _ops files must stay untouched. Review this handoff and give the corrected R3 setup/transaction approach. Do not run it.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed correction that moves all process artifacts outside Nutstore, uses the host-bound profile and shared skill, and leaves existing _ops content untouched except for the exact transient lock during a real transaction.
expectations: Rejects the plan and WorkRoot locations because they are inside or overlap the Vault.
Explains that Device, VaultRoot, WorkRoot, and Python come from a one-time host-bound local profile and cannot be overridden on the transaction command.
Places plan, snapshot, staging, backup, journal, reports, runtime, and index cwd outside the Vault.
Identifies _ops/governance.lock.json as the only transient Vault process-file exception and leaves all existing _ops content untouched.
Uses setup-device.ps1 once and then run_ingest_pipeline.ps1 with only plan, SyncConfirmed, and optional recovery/index switches.
